messages:
anya: Heads-up  privacy and legal signed off on the new handbook appendix (v1.3). Need an ops checklist + a tiny manager microlearning and the ack tracking.

julie: On it. Ill write a concise handbook blurb + a one-question FAQ entry: when retention starts.

miguel: Policy notes for the blurb: personal account data removed within 30 days from termination date unless a legal hold; backups/logs may be retained up to 12 months for investigations; device images purged unless explicit consent + manager signoff.

olivia: Operational: ops needs exact CSV columns to snapshot pre-deprovision: employee_id,name,email,manager,primary_repo_access,last_login,device_serial. We should run export 24h before deprovision.

sam: Training: record a 6-8min manager microlearning covering checklist + consent conversation. Managers must ack (one-click) within 7 days after an exit. Tracker columns: manager,employee_id,opt_in(Y/N),training_ack(Y/N),ack_ts.

anya: Proposed opt-in checkbox copy: "I consent to temporary retention of logs and backups for security or legal investigation (up to 12 months)." Short and clear.

julie: Draft handbook line: "When an employee separates from Redwood, personal account data will be deleted within 30 days unless subject to a legal hold or active security investigation; backups and logs may be retained for up to 12 months strictly for investigatory purposes. Employees will be offered an opt-in for short-term investigatory retention. Managers will receive a checklist and must complete the brief recorded microlearning." Thoughts?

miguel: LGTM. Add links to the retention policy and the e-sign consent form in the doc. Also note the retention clock is measured from termination date.

olivia: CLI well use for exports (ops):
```
# offboard snapshot for uid 9201
redwood-admin export --user 9201 --fields employee_id,name,email,manager,primary_repo_access,last_login,device_serial --output /tmp/offboard-9201.csv
```

sam: Will productize the 1-click ack so it writes into the tracker automatically. We should surface manager completions weekly to people ops.

hr-bot: Reminder set  publish v1.3 appendix to #people-ops-docs and schedule manager microlearning recording for 2026-07-15 09:00 PT.

anya: I'll post the handbook draft + slide checklist and the tracker link after lunch. Please review there. Thanks all :thumbsup:
